description: This is a shell script used for testing the 'git ls-files --others' command, setting up test repositories, creating files, directories, and symlinks, and verifying the behavior of the command under various conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with specified setup and verification steps.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if certain prerequisites (like symlinks support) are available.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup steps to be run after tests complete.
